LexiMind

Legal agreements such as rental agreements, sale deeds, NDAs and affidavits are hard for ordinary readers, and harder when tools translate Telugu into English first. LexiMind simplifies a document in its own language, then extracts facts, flags risks and answers questions grounded only in the uploaded text.

The gap

Tools that translate instead of simplifying, miss clauses in generic summaries, can’t read scanned deeds, give no structured clause or risk view, and may invent details not in the contract.

What it does

Same-language simplification, clause classification, key-fact extraction (parties, dates, amounts, periods, property), heuristic risk flags, retrieval-based Q&A with citations, and DOCX, PDF, TXT and Markdown reports.

Seven-stage pipeline

  1. IngestPDF, DOCX, TXT and images; PyMuPDF, python-docx, and Tesseract OCR (Telugu + English) for scans.
  2. NormalizeRepair line wraps, remove OCR noise, standardise sentences.
  3. Detect languageTelugu Unicode block (U+0C00–U+0C7F) versus English letters: Telugu, English or mixed.
  4. SegmentHeadings, numbered clauses, sections and signature blocks.
  5. SimplifyRule-based rewriting of English legalese and archaic Telugu, plus TextRank summaries; optional Gemini or OpenAI rewriting.
  6. Extract and assessParties, amounts, dates, durations, property details, then rule-based flags for unfavourable clauses.
  7. Answer and exportTF-IDF word and character n-grams with cosine similarity; “Information not found” when the document doesn’t say.
174rewriting rules (114 English, 60 Telugu)
57glossary terms (32 English, 25 Telugu)
9test documents: 4 English, 3 Telugu, 1 mixed, 1 scanned
85.8%Telugu characters detected in the demo deed (110 words)

Reference resources

CUAD, ContractNLI, LegalBench, ILDC, IndicNLP resources and Tesseract Telugu data informed the clause taxonomy, risk rules and Q&A design.

These resources guided design and rule-writing. No new model was trained or fine-tuned. LexiMind is an informational tool and doesn’t replace professional legal advice.
